items.title: Bengaluru police conduct late night raids on 400-500 pubs, bars across city
items.snippet: Bengaluru Police Commissioner Seemanth Kumar Singh led a late-night crackdown on pubs and bars across the city, with around 1,500 police personnel conducting raids and inspections at 400 to 500 locations to check violations of operating hours, underage drinking, and other alleged irregularities, he said on Saturday.

items.title: Hilton’s Tempo Set For Europe Debut in Munich, with Rooftop Bar and Arena Next Door
items.snippet: Hilton’s lifestyle brand is expanding into Europe, with its 199-room property set to bring a rooftop bar, gym and café to Munich’s growing entertainment district near the airport.

items.title: WTTC & ICCA sign MoU to boost business events
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) and the International Congress and Convention Association (ICCA) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen collaboration between the global Travel & Tourism sector and the international meetings and business events industry. The agreement was signed during WTTC’s 26th Global Summit in Valletta, Malta.

items.title: TAWI LUSH joins Skål International to strengthen global hospitality connections
items.snippet: TAWI LUSH Pvt. Ltd., a founder-led hospitality advisory and commercial representation company, has joined Skål International, expanding its engagement with the global network of travel and tourism professionals.

items.title: India’s Foreign Arrivals Are Falling — but the 2047 Tourism Target Is Now 100 Million
items.snippet: Skift Take: India has listed out four Ps for hitting 100 million visitors. It lacks a fifth: a published path. With arrivals falling, the hope is there’s a plan behind the promise, before this turns into a pipe dream.

items.title: Accor signs Pullman Udaipur, scheduled to open in 2030
items.snippet: Accor has signed Pullman Udaipur, marking the brand’s entry into the city. Developed in partnership with Kings Luxury Resorts Pvt. Ltd., the 200-key property is scheduled to open in 2030, further expanding Accor’s presence in Rajasthan. The hotel will be located on Airport Road, within the Maharana Pratap Airport corridor, an emerging hospitality and commercial district in Udaipur.

items.title: Braemar advances Ashford spinout with $372M Four Seasons sale
items.snippet: With the Four Seasons Resort Scottsdale under contract and a settlement agreement reached in its dispute with shareholder Al Shams, Braemar is on track to transition to self-management.

items.title: Market Beat Germany - H1 2026
items.snippet: German hotel investment volume fell to €600M in H1 2026 from €1.1B a year earlier, while operating metrics held steady with RevPAR flat at €74 and prime yields stable at 6.5%.

items.title: Tivoli to Open 71-Key Aarunya Club & Convention in Greater Noida
items.snippet: Tivoli Hospitality Group will open Aarunya Club & Convention by Tivoli in Greater Noida on November 15, 2026, with 71 rooms and an expanded portfolio of indoor and outdoor event venues targeting weddings, social celebrations, leisure stays and the Meetings, Incentives, Conferences and Exhibitions (MICE) segment.

items.title: It’s a wrap! THINC Indonesia 2026
items.snippet: It’s a wrap! THINC Indonesia 2026 by Hotelivate | Oct 9, 2026 THINC Indonesia 2026 brought together hotel owners, investors, operators, developers, advisors and technology leaders for two days of conversations on what is shaping hospitality across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. The tone was optimistic, but measured.
